mapper.insert: INSERT INTO afv_async_outbox(event_key, event_type, aggregate_id, payload_json, next_attempt_at, created_at) VALUES (#{key}, #{type}, #{aggregate}, #{payload}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))
mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.event_type, o.aggregate_id, o.payload_json FROM afv_async_outbox o WHERE o.state = 'PENDING' AND o.event_type IN ('GENERATION_ACCEPTED', 'GENERATION_CHANGED', 'COMFY_TEST_ACCEPTED', 'COMFY_TEST_CHANGED', 'COMFY_TEST_REVIEW', 'COMFY_TEST_RECEIPT', 'CANVAS_RUN_ACCEPTED', 'CANVAS_RUN_CHANGED', 'CANVAS_RUN_SELECTION', 'CANVAS_RUN_CANCELLED', 'CANVAS_RUN_BATCH_REVIEW', 'CANVAS_RUN_WRITEBACK', 'CANVAS_MEDIA_ACCEPTED', 'CANVAS_MEDIA_CHANGED', 'CANVAS_MEDIA_REVIEW', 'EPISODE_AUDIO_REVIEW', 'MEDIA_IMPORT_ACCEPTED', 'MEDIA_IMPORT_CHANGED', 'MEDIA_IMPORT_CANCELLED', 'MEDIA_IMPORT_RETRY', 'MEDIA_IMPORT_PLACED', 'MEDIA_PREVIEW_ACCEPTED', 'MEDIA_PREVIEW_CHANGED', 'CANVAS_TEXT_ACCEPTED', 'CANVAS_TEXT_CHANGED', 'CANVAS_TEXT_RECEIVED', 'CANVAS_TEXT_REVIEW') AND o.next_attempt_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM afv_async_outbox prior WHERE prior.aggregate_id = o.aggregate_id AND prior.state = 'PENDING' AND prior.id < o.id) ORDER BY o.id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE afv_async_outbox SET next_attempt_at = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, LEAST(60, POW(2, LEAST(attempts + 1, 6))), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)), attempts = attempts + 1, last_error = #{error} WHERE id = #{id} AND state = 'PENDING'
UPDATE afv_async_outbox SET state = 'DELIVERED', attempts = attempts + 1, last_error = NULL, delivered_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id}
